modes.description: Baseline transfer: hybrid retrieval thresholded at synthetic tau=0.50 without LLM
Recalibrated vector: hybrid retrieval thresholded at tau=0.70 without LLM
Hybrid retrieval with tau=0.50 passed to Condition 3 LLM Semantic Verification

findings_summary: Evaluated 3 guard architectures on 15 authentic CUAD contracts (105 cases) using live Vertex AI (vertex_ai, model=gemini-3.5-flash). Pure vector retrieval at tau=0.50 achieves 27.9% correct abstention (false abs: 0.0%, Macro F1: 0.4564). Raising threshold to tau=0.70 yields 40.5% correct abstention at cost of 26.9% false abstentions (Macro F1: 0.4777). Condition 3 LLM verification (inspecting top-5 passing candidates) achieves 75.9% correct abstention with 65.4% false abstentions (Macro F1: 0.5513), mean latency 5153.1ms, and estimated cost $0.6262/1k queries (measured tokens: 83552 prompt / 7993 candidate; rates: $0.50/$3.00 per 1M tokens from config/pricing.yaml). Conditioned analysis confirms retrieval is the primary bottleneck: among present clauses, retrieval Hit@1 is only 26.9% (Hit@5: 61.5%). When the retriever successfully brings the true clause into top-5, the LLM verifier confirms 8 cases, and when retrieval misses, the LLM correctly rejects 9 irrelevant passages as false evidence.
